title: PFedHASNet: A Personalized Federated Hybrid Analog-Spike Network for Multi-Subject Motor Imagery EEG Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.32019v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Motor imagery electroencephalography (MI-EEG) data are often collected and stored separately across subjects or institutions, and EEG acquisition and annotation remain costly. Training models solely on individual subject data limits the use of information from other subjects, whereas centralizing raw EEG recordings raises privacy and data governance concerns. Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without sharing raw EEG data, providing a practical approach to leveraging information from multiple subjects. Accordingly, we propose PFedHASNet, a personalized federated hybrid analog-spike network for MI-EEG decoding. The shared encoder integrates continuous-valued temporal features, leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) spike responses, and channel-wise log-variance statistics through learnable fusion weights. translated_title: PFedHASNet：一种用于多被试运动想象脑电解码的个性化联邦混合模拟-脉冲网络
translated_abstract: 运动想象脑电（MI-EEG）数据通常在不同被试或机构之间分散采集与存储，且脑电的采集和标注成本高昂。仅基于单个被试数据训练模型会限制对其他被试信息的利用，而集中收集原始脑电记录则会引发隐私和数据治理方面的担忧。联邦学习（FL）能够在不共享原始脑电数据的情况下，实现分布式客户端之间的协同模型训练，为利用多个被试的信息提供了一种实用的方法。据此，我们提出了PFedHASNet，一种用于运动想象脑电解码的个性化联邦混合模拟-脉冲网络。共享编码器通过可学习的融合权重，整合了连续值时间特征、泄漏积分发放（LIF）脉冲响应以及通道级的对数方差统计量。客户端私有的残差适配器和分类器执行面向特定被试的特征精炼……
tldr: 该论文提出PFedHASNet，一种个性化联邦混合模拟-脉冲网络，通过可学习权重融合连续时间特征与LIF脉冲响应，并借助客户端私有的残差适配器和分类器，在保护数据隐私的前提下实现多被试运动想象脑电的个性化解码。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PFedHASNet, a personalized federated hybrid analog-spike network that fuses continuous temporal features with LIF spike responses via learnable weights and employs client-private residual adapters and classifiers to enable privacy-preserving, subject-specific multi-subject motor imagery EEG decoding.
